baseline_cn: 任务成功不能由HTTP状态推断
extension_en: Output/node/trajectory audits plus an independently named outcome record.
extension_cn: 输出、节点、轨迹之外增加具名结果观察。
boundary: No independent trust in an arbitrary submitted observer.

baseline_en: Quality / Cost / Safety plus system health
baseline_cn: 保留系统健康及质量、成本、安全
extension_en: Separate assurance coordinates; hard violations cannot be offset by quality or savings.
extension_cn: 独立结算各维度；质量或节省不能抵消硬约束违规。
boundary: Does not replace infrastructure monitoring collectors.

extension_en: Frozen manifests, exact cross-split hashes and provenance-group leakage checks.
extension_cn: 冻结清单，检查跨分区精确重复和来源组泄漏。
boundary: No semantic near-duplicate or pretraining-contamination detector.

baseline_cn: 异常优先与随机基准采样
extension_en: Display unweighted result, inverse-inclusion weighted ratio and unknown sampling design.
extension_cn: 分开报告原始比例、逆入选概率加权结果与未知采样设计。
boundary: No invented population CI when the sampling design is unspecified.

baseline_cn: 结果、节点、轨迹三级粒度
extension_en: Executable declared checks, tool scopes, lineage namespaces and outcome postconditions.
extension_cn: 执行性断言、工具范围、记忆命名空间及结果后置条件。

extension_en: No aggregate acceptance score. Advisory judge disagreement stays visible; local execution is sequential.
extension_cn: 不生成综合准入分；保留Judge分歧；当前执行为顺序模式。
boundary: Distributed asynchronous scheduler is not implemented.

extension_en: Confusion, abstention, conditional error intervals, Brier and family metadata.
extension_cn: 混淆矩阵、弃权、条件误差区间、Brier与模型家族元数据。
boundary: Calibration consumes supplied judgments; no live model calls or automatic judge training.

extension_en: Subset OTLP/JSON adapter with mapping-loss report; no hidden CoT collection.
extension_cn: OTLP/JSON子集适配及映射损失说明；不采集隐藏思维链。
boundary: Not a collector, full OTLP exporter or semantic-conventions certification.

extension_en: New explicit evidence-to-outcome planes, without inventing the missing source diagram.
extension_cn: 独立提出证据到结果的架构平面，不补造附件缺图。
boundary: The supplied section contains an image placeholder, not readable six-layer definitions.

extension_en: Human-editable scaffold and strict executable project.json; declarative check allowlist.
extension_cn: 可审阅脚手架与严格project.json；仅执行白名单声明式检查。
boundary: No conversational test generation and no arbitrary checks.py execution.

extension_en: Execute paired cases and all trials; reset local state; retain errors/timeouts; group bootstrap.
extension_cn: 真实运行配对案例及重复试验；重置本地状态；保留错误与超时；按组重采样。
boundary: Built-ins are toy Python/SQLite carriers, not frontier LLM benchmarks.

baseline_cn: 改善是否真由组件带来
extension_en: Finite controlled read-removal intervention and no-effect memory-metadata negative control.
extension_cn: 有限环境的读取能力移除实验，以及无效果的记忆元数据负对照。
boundary: Cannot infer general causal necessity from this constructed environment.

extension_en: Recorded observations feed quarantined proposals, local rollout states and signed outcome events.
extension_cn: 观察记录进入隔离提案、本地发布状态及签名结果事件。
boundary: No production traffic connector or automatic live deployment/rollback.

extension_en: Evidence correction reopens dependent claims/reports/releases while independent branches persist.
extension_cn: 证据纠正重新打开依赖主张、报告与发布；保留无关分支。
boundary: Creates review annotations; does not automatically fabricate replacement knowledge.

extension_en: Failure proposals preserve source and cannot rewrite test labels; new versions require review.
extension_cn: 失败提案保留来源且不能改写测试标签；新版本必须复核。
boundary: No prompt optimizer or model fine-tuning is included.

extension_en: CI tests, frozen artifact-bound gates, separate approvals, expiry and locally reversible registry.
extension_cn: CI测试、绑定构件的评估门禁、独立批准、有效期与本地可回退状态。
boundary: Shared-key holder is the local trust root; no verified human identity or production attestation.
